Let \( a_0, a_1, a_2, \ldots \) be the unique sequence of nonnegative integers less than 397 with \( a_0 = 1 \) and

\[ a_{n+1}(a_n + 1)^2 \equiv a_n \pmod{397} \]

for all nonnegative integers \( n \). Given that \( a_{2026} = 9 \), compute the remainder when \( a_0 + a_1 + \cdots + a_{2026} \) is divided by 397.

Put your final answer within \boxed{}.

message.content:
Work modulo \(397\). Since the sequence is defined and \(a_{2026}=9\), the relevant terms are nonzero, so we may take inverses.

Let

\[
b_n \equiv a_n^{-1} \pmod{397}.
\]

From

\[
a_{n+1}(a_n+1)^2 \equiv a_n \pmod{397},
\]

we get

\[
a_{n+1} \equiv a_n(a_n+1)^{-2}.
\]

Taking reciprocals,

\[
b_{n+1} \equiv (a_n+1)^2 a_n^{-1}
= a_n+2+a_n^{-1}
= b_n^{-1}+2+b_n.
\]

Thus

\[
a_n = b_n^{-1} \equiv b_{n+1}-b_n-2 \pmod{397}.
\]

Therefore,

\[
\sum_{n=0}^{2026} a_n
\equiv \sum_{n=0}^{2026} (b_{n+1}-b_n-2)
= b_{2027}-b_0-2\cdot 2027.
\]

Now \(b_0=a_0^{-1}=1\). Also \(a_{2026}=9\), so

\[
b_{2026}=9^{-1}.
\]

Then

\[
b_{2027}
\equiv b_{2026}+2+b_{2026}^{-1}
\equiv 9^{-1}+2+9
\equiv 9^{-1}+11.
\]

Since \(9\cdot 44=396\equiv -1\pmod{397}\), we have

\[
9^{-1}\equiv -44\equiv 353 \pmod{397}.
\]

So

\[
b_{2027}\equiv 353+11=364 \pmod{397}.
\]

Finally,

\[
2\cdot 2027=4054\equiv 84 \pmod{397},
\]

and hence

\[
\sum_{n=0}^{2026} a_n
\equiv 364-1-84
\equiv 279 \pmod{397}.
\]

\[
\boxed{279}
\]
